## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by the Míng Buddhist scholar [善堅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E5%A0%85) Shànjiān is a compact synopsis of the *[Avataṃsaka](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0010)*'s main doctrinal-narrative content, suitable for late-Míng monastic and lay readers. The *dà yì* "main idea" format is one of the standard late-imperial East Asian Buddhist literary genres for accessible doctrinal introduction.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1500 – 1600) reflects the broad Míng period of [善堅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E5%A0%85) Shànjiān's activity. The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1023) collection.
